description:
Set a metadata key-value pair on an agent identity in the ERC-8004 identity registry. Value must be a hex-encoded buffer (max 512 bytes). The key "agentWallet" is reserved — use identity_set_wallet instead. Requires an unlocked wallet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

fee.description: Fee preset ("low", "medium", "high") or micro-STX amount. Optional.

sponsored.description: Use sponsored transaction relay so a relay service pays fees instead of your wallet. Requires SPONSOR_API_KEY env var or wallet-level sponsorApiKey.

value.description: Metadata value as hex-encoded buffer (e.g., "616c696365" for "alice"). Max 512 bytes.

name: identity_set_metadata
